notes: Development ledger reflecting current repository reality: deterministic policy plumbing and invariant unit tests on synthetic cases with known gaps. Real multilingual voice models (ASR), anti-spoof diagnostics (AASIST), separated sealed media, immutable Evaluation Version, and human validation have not been executed.

admission.rules: Enforces complete Processing Authority Record (permitted uses, route, redaction, bounded retention) and allowlisted non-empty evidence payload before opening a Risk Case. Persists only hashes and safe metadata.
admission.known_gap: Automated MIME detection is client-declared in MVP; media parsing and anti-spoofing diagnostics deferred to P0-2.

intent_extraction_and_confirmation.features: INR normalization, candidate extraction, operator confirmation, material edit invalidation.

deterministic_policy_gate.evaluator: Pure total deterministic Python evaluator over frozen snapshots.
deterministic_policy_gate.known_gap: Direct evaluation of unadmitted or rejected input preserves Admission Rejection semantics; snapshot hash re-verification across storage restarts remains in development.

grants_and_hmac.security: Single-use expiring HMAC-SHA256 grants with unique nonces and case/intent/snapshot hash binding.
grants_and_hmac.known_gap: Replay tracking relies on volatile memory and snapshot hash is not reverified on evaluation; partial unit coverage only.

audit_hash_chain.properties: Authoritative append-only SHA-256 audit_events ledger with authenticated case_audit_checkpoints HMAC-SHA256 MACs (PAYOUTPROOF_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_V1) verifying tip hash, event count, and sequential integrity fail-closed.
audit_hash_chain.known_gap: Single-node SQLite checkpointing; distributed multi-node consensus remains a known gap deferred to later tickets.

fake_action_adapter.boundary: Creates exactly one pending item in maker-checker approval rail; enforces replay rejection and ambiguity reconciliation. External payment adapters (RazorpayX) are explicitly deferred.
fake_action_adapter.known_gap: Server-owned handoff boundary is component-tested with atomic SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions and durable replay records; production integration with live payment rails remains a known gap deferred to later tickets.

persistence.engine: SQLite WAL persistence for cases, grants, adapter attempts, and audit events.
persistence.known_gap: adapter_attempts and pending_approval_items are written durably within atomic transactions; distributed multi-node consensus remains a known gap deferred to later tickets.

simulator_oracle_scorer.description: Centralized EvaluationExecutionService running dev (45), sealed (90), and safety (81 repeated: 27 base cases x 3 repetitions) synthetic policy harnesses with zero mismatches and zero unsafe handoffs within the synthetic harness only. Held-out evaluation, real models, and human validation remain not executed.

api_control_plane.framework: FastAPI with OpenAPI specification and CORS.
api_control_plane.known_gap: Admission authority bypass and mutable case transitions exposed via API endpoints; partial unit coverage only.

web_presentation.framework: Vite + React + TypeScript with operator console, guided walkthroughs, and development policy harness runner.
web_presentation.known_gap: Interactive review features in active development; paired human interaction reduction not yet evidenced.

zero_tolerance_safety_gate.target: 0 Unsafe Handoffs across all cases and repeated runs
zero_tolerance_safety_gate.notes: Held-out target is NOT_RUN; only the 81 repeated synthetic safety executions (27 base cases × 3 repetitions) were verified.

three_action_accuracy.notes: Target gate for held-out evaluation; not yet evidenced on real held-out corpus.

protective_intervention_recall.notes: Target gate for held-out evaluation; not yet evidenced on real held-out corpus.

intent_binding_correctness.notes: Target gate for held-out evaluation; not yet evidenced on real held-out corpus.

operator_interaction_reduction.notes: Target gate for paired workflow comparison; not yet evidenced with human reviewers.

tamper_detection_gate.target: Corrupted audit sequences detected and flagged as invalid
tamper_detection_gate.notes: Verified in unit suite: authenticated case_audit_checkpoints HMAC-SHA256 fail-closed on tail truncation, interior deletion, row tampering, sequence reordering, and cross-case events; distributed multi-node consensus remains a known gap.

replay_prevention_gate.target: Replay of consumed grant or duplicate idempotency key rejected
replay_prevention_gate.notes: Partial unit checks with known gaps: durable SQLite replay prevention, restart safety, and multi-instance concurrency verified in unit tests; distributed multi-node consensus remains a known gap.
